title: Summarize every group with new messages
what: Summarizes, one by one, each group allowed for the AI that has new messages since the last summary (the first time it takes the last 24 hours). While the app is open, groups with new messages are summarized in the background at most once every 2 hours (turn off in Settings › Telegram › Auto-summarize Briefing). A group whose AI access is about to expire or has expired shows a "Renew for 30 days" line in Briefing.

how.t: In the sidebar's "AI assistant" section, click "Briefing" (the orange number = groups with new messages)

Click "Summarize new messages · N groups" to summarize the groups with new messages one by one (the button only shows when there are unsummarized messages); the middle of the page shows which group the AI is reading

how: While summarizing: the "Summary" button at the top right becomes a round red stop button (with an n/N group count for several groups); click it to cancel midway

how.t: To summarize one group: hover the group in the sidebar's "Groups · Briefing" section and click ✦
Change the model / effort just for Briefing under the Briefing assistant's question box
Click the circular "Check again" icon to look for new messages (a group with a yellow exclamation mark: Telegram could not be read for it, so whether it has news is not known)

title: Briefing assistant: ask the AI about every group
what: The right column (on phones: the "AI assistant" tab; on desktop hidden by default so the list is wider: click "Ask AI" at the top right to open it, X in the panel to hide it, the chat is kept and the app remembers your choice; available once at least one group is summarized) is a chat about the latest summary of every group: what to do first today, who is waiting on you, blockers, writing a standup… The AI reads only the summaries, no further Telegram messages. Answers can be copied or sent to Saved Messages. Each sourced point carries a group · #message chip (hover to see the item) and the same buttons as Briefing's rows: "Reply", "Create ticket", "Check code" (BE questions, decisions / changes; Dev role). Questions to ask come ready per group, each message with a copy button and "Ask in Q&A": that group's Q&A opens with the question filled in, tag who you ask, then send. Under the latest answer a few "Ask next" questions fill the box when clicked. Each chat is saved under AI Agent › Briefing in this browser.

how.t: In the sidebar's "AI assistant" section, click "Briefing" (the orange number = groups with new messages)
On desktop, click the "Ask AI" button (robot) at the top right
Click a suggestion card, or type a question in the "Ask about every group…" box and press Enter

how: Click the stop button while the AI is answering to cancel; the trash icon at the top of the panel clears the chat
keys: ask ai briefing what to do today standup blockers risks who is waiting on me all groups chat ai

title: To do across all groups (For you, To confirm, To-dos…)
what: Gathers questions needing confirmation, to-dos, decisions and changes from the latest summary of every group into one list with filter tabs. The "Needs you" tab shows only items asked of / assigned to you (by your YouTrack name; PO/PM for the PO role). Tick the circle to mark an item handled (saved on the dashboard server: every browser / machine sees it). Items where you replied to the original message on Telegram (sent from the app or from Telegram) move to handled by themselves, marked "You replied". To-dos without a ticket are checked against YouTrack: a similar ticket shows "may already exist …", otherwise a prominent "No ticket · Create" button appears. With a role that uses code, every to-do has "Check code" (the AI reads the code: done yet, how far) and "AI Agent" (hand it to the AI Agent, the to-do already in the extra request; once handed over the button shows the session's state, click to open it). The To-dos tab has "Check code for N to-dos" at the top of each group to check them all in one session; each to-do shows "Code: adapted / off / not done" from the latest check ("old" when newer messages came in), and to-dos the AI finds done move to handled (with Undo). A decision naming a ticket has "record on …" to add it as a comment (not for the PO/PM role: "Update story" edits the description and leaves the comment); a change to a ticket in a sprint shows "changes sprint … scope". Items nobody resolved in the last summary stay, labeled "open since …"; a Settled / Change item naming a ticket and not put in its story yet stays too (labeled "not in the story since …") until Update story or marked done, so QC tests what was decided.

how.t: In the sidebar's "AI assistant" section, click "Briefing" (the orange number = groups with new messages)
Pick a tab: For you, To confirm, To-dos, Settled, Changes (the number next to it = unhandled items)
Click "Reply" / "Create ticket" / "Check code" / "AI Agent" right under an item, or click the group name to open the group's summary
Click the circle at the start of a line to mark it handled; "Handled N" at the bottom to review / unmark

title: Items waiting on someone else (To follow up) and Update story
what: Each To confirm / To-do / Decided / Change item has a "Waiting on…" button that puts an item still waiting on someone else on the "To follow up" tab; a Q&A thread has "Waiting on…" too, on its "Đã chốt" bar (not settled yet: on the AI conclusion card), e.g. settled but still waiting on a design / the BU. The reasons follow your role (the Role box on YouTrack, or Settings): PO/PM "Waiting on design" / "Waiting on BU"; Dev "Waiting on BE" / "Needs PO"; QA "Waiting on build" / "Waiting on fix"; change them in Settings › Telegram › Briefing › "Wait reasons" (× to drop one, add another role's built-in reason or type your own such as "Waiting on the client"; a reason of your own shows "Looks done" once someone replies to the original message). On a group's "Whole group" tab every message (yours too) has a ⌛ "Waiting on…" button in its action strip to follow it until someone replies. The item leaves the open list; the list is saved on the dashboard server, so every browser / machine sees it, kept even when a later summary no longer has it. On that tab each item shows its age (red "waiting N days" past 3 days); "Remind" opens the reply box on the original message with a drafted reminder (e.g. "Nhờ BE hỗ trợ giúp…", "Nhờ fix giúp…") with whoever must answer / do it already @tagged when found in the group (else type @ yourself); tick the circle once it is no longer waiting; "Stop waiting" puts it back in the open list. Once a day, on any page (Telegram, YouTrack, Documents, Settings), the app reminds you when something has waited over 3 days (a system notification when the app is in the background and Notifications are on). Briefing's Saved Messages button also sends the To follow up items. PO/PM role only: To confirm / Decided / Change items have "Update story" (put what was decided into the ticket description: edit it yourself or have the AI draft it, then "Save"; the YouTrack comment and the Telegram reply to the deciding message are each sent with their own button, type @ or click a quick-tag group to tag); a saved item shows "In story VA-1" and moves to handled. Picking "Waiting on design" for an item with a ticket offers moving it to the project's design state (e.g. ASSIGN TO DESIGN); ticking a waiting item done offers "Update story". When what it waits on has happened, the item shows "Looks done" with why and a "Close" button (never closed by itself): waiting on fix / build / design follows its first ticket's state (moved to test / built / left the design state, after the wait began); waiting on BE / PO / BU, someone replied to the original message on Telegram. An item put into a story and handled still shows "In story VA-1" under Handled.

how.t: Under “AI assistant” in the sidebar, click “Briefing”
On an open item (To confirm / To-do / Decided / Change), click “Waiting on…”
Pick what it waits on (PO/PM: Waiting on design / Waiting on BU; Dev: Waiting on BE / Needs PO; QA: Waiting on build / Waiting on fix)
Open the “To follow up” tab to see what is still waiting

how: Each item shows its age (red past 3 days); once what it waits on has happened it shows “Looks done” with why and a “Close” button. Tick the circle when it is no longer waiting, “Stop waiting” puts it back in the open list; PO/PM also get “Update story”

how.t: Click “Remind”: the reply box opens on the original message with a drafted reminder, whoever must answer already @tagged; review, then send

title: Put what the group decided into the story (Update story)
what: PO/PM role: To confirm / Decided / Change items in Briefing have an “Update story” button. The item (with its context) is shown above the description box for you to put into the story, and is the change already filled in if you ask the AI to draft. A saved item shows “In story VA-1” and moves to handled; click it again to update once more. The Telegram message replies to the deciding message. In the dialog: the description opens ready to edit by hand, AI is just the “AI” chip to click when needed (its draft opens on the “Compare” tab). The description box has three tabs: “Write” to edit, “Compare” for the lines added / removed against what YouTrack has, “Preview” for the description as YouTrack will show it. “Save” only writes the description to YouTrack; tick “Add the comment and send to Telegram” next to “Save” (off by default) and “Save” also sends the comment and the Telegram message. “Who to tell” has two independent boxes, neither waits for the other nor for “Save”: “Comment on YouTrack” (“Send comment”) and “Telegram message” (“Send to Telegram”, posted straight to the group). Each box starts with a ready line tagging the Assignee / QC the platform's own way (YouTrack by login, Telegram by the group member's @username), freely editable; type @ to pick from that platform's people. Under each box are quick-tag groups (Android, iOS, FE, BE, QA/QC by default): click one to tag the whole group; ⚙ renames groups, adds / removes people or adds a group (kept in this browser, per platform). The number beside a group is how many people it has; people are remembered with their names, so they still show before a Telegram group is picked. A Telegram send that loses the connection midway reads “not sure it was sent”: check the group before “Send again”.

how.t: Under “AI assistant” in the sidebar, click “Briefing”
Pick the To confirm, Decided or Change tab
Click “Update story” under an item
Check the ticket ID at the top, then edit right in the “Description” box (a missing AC, a new decision)

how: The “Compare” tab shows lines added (green) and removed (red); the “Preview” tab shows the description as on YouTrack. Want the AI to draft it: click the “AI” chip, write the change, then “Draft”; its text lands in this same box for you to review

“Who to tell” has two separate boxes, each with its own send button: “Comment on YouTrack” and “Telegram message”. Type freely, type @ to tag (each platform lists its own people), or click a quick-tag group (Android, iOS, FE, BE, QA/QC); the ⚙ icon edits those groups

how.t: Click “Save” to write the description to YouTrack (blocked when someone has just edited it on YouTrack: “Load the latest to edit”). Tick “Add the comment and send to Telegram” before saving to send both along; otherwise the dialog stays open so you can send each one

title: Groups in the sidebar: filter, summarize, open, remove
what: The sidebar's "Groups · Briefing" section lists the groups: yellow dot = new messages, green = up to date, number = open items (it drops as you mark them handled). Click a group to see only its items; hover a group for ✦ summarize the group, ↗ open the Summary page, 🗑 remove from Briefing (confirm box "Remove group from Briefing?"; the AI stops reading the group and its summary is deleted; add it back with "Add group"). The Copy button at the top right copies every summary as one Markdown.

how.t: In the sidebar's "AI assistant" section, click "Briefing" (the orange number = groups with new messages)
Click a group in the "Groups · Briefing" section to see only its items; click "Briefing" to see everything again
Hover a group and click ↗ to open the group's Summary page
Hover a group, click the trash can, then click "Remove group" in the confirm box
Click "Copy all" to copy the Markdown of every group

title: Send the briefing to Saved Messages
what: Sends the unhandled items of every group (needs confirmation, to-dos, decided, changes) as one message to your Saved Messages on Telegram, to read on your phone. Ask AI answers can be sent too.

how.t: In the sidebar's "AI assistant" section, click "Briefing" (the orange number = groups with new messages)
Click the paper plane icon "Send to Saved Messages" at the top right

how: Or in an Ask AI answer, click "Send to Saved Messages"

title: Add a group that never tagged you to Briefing
what: Pick any Telegram group (even one that never tagged you) to open its Summary; click Allow there and the group joins Briefing. Groups not yet allowed for the AI come first in "Add group" (at the end of the sidebar's "Groups · Briefing" section).
